# Ghayur Accounts and Tax Services (GATS)

> Independent, family-run accounting and tax firm in Mississauga, Ontario, established 2001. Corporate (T2) and personal (T1) tax, bookkeeping, payroll, HST/GST, incorporations, and specialist work for licensed childcare centres (CWELCC funding reconciliations), physicians and medical professional corporations, not-for-profits and charities, newcomers and cross-border (Canada, US, UK) individuals, e-commerce sellers on Shopify and Amazon (including US state sales tax registration and filing), manufacturers, franchises, restaurants and builders. Works remotely with clients across Canada.

- Phone: 647-870-8498
- Email: office@ghayurtax.com
- Office: 100-51 Village Centre Place, Mississauga, ON L4Z 1V9, Canada
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 10 am to 6 pm (Eastern)
- Contact by phone or email; no online booking calendar. A quote form at https://www.ghayurtax.com/quote.html composes an email for the client to send. Documents are sent through a secure Intuit Link portal, never by email.
- Payment: Interac e-Transfer to office@ghayurtax.com
- Fees: most personal tax returns are CA$80; add $40 per rental property; taxi and Uber drivers $150; self-employed and complex returns quoted up front. Ontario numbered incorporation from CA$599.

- Team: includes Chartered Professional Accountants who prepare compilation engagement reports and other CPA-specific work. Audits are performed by an independent licensed public accountant; GATS keeps the books audit-ready and coordinates the audit.
- AI: AI-assisted bookkeeping and accounting with human review, plus AI strategy and custom AI solutions for small businesses (for example, an online learning platform built for a client).

## Services and specialties

- [Home and services overview](https://www.ghayurtax.com/): personal tax, corporate tax, bookkeeping in Excel or QuickBooks Online (whichever the client uses), payroll and HST, financial reporting, cross-border tax, business advice
- [Childcare operators and CWELCC](https://www.ghayurtax.com/childcare.html): CWELCC cost-based funding reconciliations, spending plans and payroll wage rules for licensed centres in Peel, Halton and Toronto
- [Physicians and medical professional corporations](https://www.ghayurtax.com/medical.html): MPC year-ends, T2s, salary versus dividends, when a physician should incorporate
- [Regulated health clinics](https://www.ghayurtax.com/clinic-accounting-ontario.html): bookkeeping, payroll, HST and corporate tax for chiropractic, optometry, physiotherapy, psychology and veterinary clinics
- [Not-for-profits and charities](https://www.ghayurtax.com/nonprofits.html): fund-tracked bookkeeping, financial statements, T3010 and T1044 returns, HST rebates
- [Newcomers and cross-border](https://www.ghayurtax.com/newcomers.html): first Canadian return, US and UK income, residency, foreign tax credits
- [Incorporation](https://www.ghayurtax.com/incorporation.html): incorporation prepared and filed by the firm, federally or in any province, from CA$599 for an Ontario numbered corporation (government fee included); named, federal, professional and out-of-province corporations quoted after a call
- [AI solutions](https://www.ghayurtax.com/ai.html): AI-assisted bookkeeping with human review, AI strategy sessions and custom AI builds for small businesses, daycares and medical practices

## CWELCC guides (2026 guidelines)

- [The CWELCC reconciliation, step by step](https://www.ghayurtax.com/cwelcc-reconciliation.html): what Regions compare, the six steps, the 20 closure-day maximum, where recoveries start
- [CWELCC deadlines for Peel, Halton and Toronto](https://www.ghayurtax.com/cwelcc-deadlines.html)
- [2026 wage floors, WEG and workforce compensation](https://www.ghayurtax.com/cwelcc-wage-floors.html): $25.86 for RECE program staff and $26.86 for RECE supervisors and home child care visitors, the order of operations, the 17.5% benefits cap, payroll rules
- [Home child care agencies and base-fee recovery](https://www.ghayurtax.com/cwelcc-home-child-care-agencies.html): why occupancy above 95% leads to a recovery; GATS works with several licensed home child care agencies
- [How CWELCC cost-based funding works](https://www.ghayurtax.com/cwelcc-cost-based-funding.html): the benchmark allocation and top-ups, the amount in lieu of profit (4.25% + 3.5% + $6,000), the base fee revenue offset at 0.95 for 2026, and why the allocation is a ceiling
- [The December 31 year-end checklist for a centre](https://www.ghayurtax.com/cwelcc-year-end-checklist.html): what to settle before the calendar year closes, the Peel January 30 and February 13 communications, audited statements and FAIR by April 30, and the T4, T2 and T1044 filings
- [What you can and cannot charge parents](https://www.ghayurtax.com/cwelcc-parent-fees.html): the $22 a day cap, base fees versus non-base fees, the fee freeze, fee deposits as deferred revenue, and the $13.35 and $12.27 school-age rates for centres enrolling after December 31, 2024
- [CWELCC compliance engagements and cost reviews](https://www.ghayurtax.com/cwelcc-service-manager-review.html): the 5% CSAE 3531 sample, cost reviews of the top 10% by top-up ratio, what reviewers test, and the records to keep

## Guides for dentists (Ontario, 2026)

- [Dentistry professional corporations in Ontario](https://www.ghayurtax.com/dental-professional-corporation.html): RCDSO shareholder rules, $750 certificate, August 31 renewals
- [Setting up a dentistry professional corporation: requirements, naming and RCDSO Certificate of Authorization](https://www.ghayurtax.com/dental-corporation-setup-rcdso.html)

- [Associate dentists: contractor, employee and taxes](https://www.ghayurtax.com/associate-dentist-taxes.html)
- [HST for dental and orthodontic practices](https://www.ghayurtax.com/dental-hst-input-tax-credits.html): input tax credits after the CRA revoked the 35% orthodontic arrangement (fiscal years from January 1, 2025), zero-rated orthodontic appliances, why the CRA treats crowns, bridges and dentures fitted by a dentist as exempt, and fair and reasonable allocation

## Guides for regulated health clinics (Ontario, 2026)

- [Accounting for regulated health clinics](https://www.ghayurtax.com/clinic-accounting-ontario.html): chiropractic, optometry, physiotherapy, psychology and veterinary practices. Which revenue is exempt, which is zero-rated and which is taxable in each of the five; why prescription eyewear being zero-rated rather than exempt usually forces an optometry practice to register and lets it recover HST; why veterinary services are fully taxable with full input tax credits; input tax credit apportionment where a clinic makes both exempt and taxable supplies; associate classification and the HST on a clinic’s retained percentage; payroll, Employer Health Tax and WSIB; clinic bookkeeping from insurer remittances to prepaid packages

## E-commerce sellers (Shopify, Amazon, Etsy, eBay)

- [E-commerce accounting and tax](https://www.ghayurtax.com/ecommerce.html): GST/HST registration and returns, US state sales tax registered and filed on the seller's behalf, bookkeeping from gross sales, inventory and cost of goods sold across Canadian and US fulfilment centres, importing and the CARM import/export account
- [GST/HST for Shopify and Amazon sellers](https://www.ghayurtax.com/ecommerce-hst-gst-shopify-amazon.html): the $30,000 worldwide threshold (zero-rated exports count toward it), when a marketplace collects instead of the seller, and destination rates by province
- [US sales tax for Canadian sellers](https://www.ghayurtax.com/us-sales-tax-canadian-sellers.html): economic nexus thresholds by state, whether FBA inventory creates physical presence, what marketplace facilitator laws cover, and the Canada-US treaty filing position
- [Bookkeeping for Shopify and Amazon payouts](https://www.ghayurtax.com/shopify-bookkeeping-payouts.html): gross sales versus net deposits, platform reporting to the CRA, inventory valuation, six-year record retention
